faqs.question: Do I need an account to check out?
faqs.answer: No, creating an account is not required to make a purchase. However, signing up for an account is highly recommended to enjoy faster checkout, track your order history, and receive exclusive updates on product launches.

faqs.question: How long will my order take to arrive?
faqs.answer: Orders typically ship from our warehouse within 24-48 business hours if the item is in stock. Small parcel deliveries typically arrive within 2-5 business days. For freight shipments, the carrier will contact you to schedule a delivery window.

faqs.question: How can I track my order?
faqs.answer: Once your order has shipped, we will email you tracking details. Tracking updates usually appear within 24 business hours.

faqs.question: What is your shipping policy?
faqs.answer: Standard shipping is available via major carriers (UPS, FedEx, USPS). For oversized orders, freight delivery with curbside service is provided. Please inspect packages upon delivery and report any visible damage to support@example.com or (800) 555-0199.

faqs.question: What is your return policy?
faqs.answer: We accept returns within 30 days of delivery. Items must be in original condition with all packaging materials included. The customer is responsible for return shipping costs unless the item arrived damaged.

faqs.question: What is your refund policy?
faqs.answer: Once your return is received and inspected at our fulfillment center, please allow 3-5 business days for processing and another 5-10 business days for the refund to reflect on your payment method.

faqs.question: How do I cancel my order?
faqs.answer: Please call our customer care team at (800) 555-0199 or email support@example.com as quickly as possible. Orders already in fulfillment cannot be cancelled and must be processed as a standard return.

faqs.question: Do you charge sales tax?
faqs.answer: Sales tax is only charged for orders purchased or shipped within California.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept all major US credit cards.
